INSERT INTO chatroom(id, pot_listing_id) VALUES(chatroom_seq.nextval, #{potListingId})
SELECT chatroom_seq.currval FROM dual
mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, cm.CONTENT AS last_chat, cm.SENT_AT AS last_message_time, pl.title AS potInfo_title, pl.type AS potInfo_type, pl.price AS potInfo_price, pl.thumbnail AS potInfo_thumbnail, pl.status AS potInfo_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.chat_room_id = cr.id AND m.sender_uid != #{userUid} AND m.is_read = 'N' ) AS unread_chat_count FROM chatroom cr JOIN chatroom_participants crp ON cr.ID = crp.CHAT_ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CHAT_ROOM_ID, CONTENT, SENT_AT FROM ( SELECT cm.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CHAT_ROOM_ID ORDER BY SENT_AT DESC) AS rn FROM chat_message cm ) WHERE rn = 1 ) cm ON cr.ID = cm.CHAT_ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN pot_listing pl ON pl.id = cr.pot_listing_id WHERE crp.USER_UID = #{userUid} ORDER BY cr.CREATED_AT DESC
